agent.reasons: Ownership adds up to 100%. Indirectly, Kofi Kowalski owns 57% through Orchid. Through Granite, Tara Moreau owns 15.4% and Rosa Okafor 6.6%. Lena Kowalski owns 21% directly. All identified individuals passed ID checks and have no sanctions, PEP or adverse media hits. The registry filing (2025-12-22) is under 12 months old. The industry is normal and every party is located in the US, so no risk factor applies.
